title: The Two Blade Masters - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: The Two Blade Masters trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: The Two Blade Masters phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Two separate encounters in different regions, so this is a checklist item rather than a single set piece.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat Zhu Yuan and Commander Bi Feng.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
